name: playwright-ui-api-automation
description: Test Automation with playwrigth for UI + API cross browser testing and Allure report

scripts.lint: eslint . --ext .ts,.js -c config/eslint/.eslintrc.json --ignore-path config/eslint/.eslintignore && tsc --noEmit && prettier --check . --config config/eslint/.prettierrc.json --ignore-path config/eslint/.prettierignore
scripts.lint:fix: eslint . --ext .ts,.js -c config/eslint/.eslintrc.json --ignore-path config/eslint/.eslintignore --fix && prettier --write . --config config/eslint/.prettierrc.json --ignore-path config/eslint/.prettierignore
